# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest stable release of OpenCVE receives security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/opencve/opencve/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected version, a description of the issue, reproduction steps, and the potential impact. Suggested fixes are welcome.

Please do not disclose vulnerability details in public issues.
